lunch2_start.name: {name}
lunch2_start.text: *Lunchtime. Unlike yesterday, Yuna's note is in my pocket. Down the hall, Seoyeon's heading for the roof with a lunchbox. Dain's waving me toward the snack bar again. Lunch at this school is a war zone.*

lunch2_choice.name: {name}
choices: Follow Yuna's note to the library annex
Go to the snack bar with Dain

lunch2_seo_1b.name: {name}
lunch2_seo_1b.text: *The rooftop. First time here. The breeze is cool and the view is wide open. Seoyeon is setting out her lunch.*

lunch2_seo_2b.name: Seoyeon
lunch2_seo_2b.text: You actually came up here. Bold.

lunch2_seo_2b_dain.name: Seoyeon
lunch2_seo_2b_dain.text: Yesterday you were headed for the store. Today you came all the way up here.

lunch2_seo_3b_dain.name: {name}
lunch2_seo_3b_dain.text: Dain dragged me off yesterday. Today, I wanted to come up here myself.

lunch2_seo_5b_dain.name: {name}
lunch2_seo_5b_dain.text: The breeze is nice. And I kept thinking about your lunchbox.

lunch2_seo_6b_dain.name: Seoyeon
lunch2_seo_6b_dain.text: ...You're more honest than I gave you credit for.

lunch2_seo_2b_yuna.name: Seoyeon
lunch2_seo_2b_yuna.text: You got a note and still came to the rooftop.

lunch2_seo_3b_yuna.name: {name}
lunch2_seo_3b_yuna.text: Yesterday was the quiet option, so today I got curious about your side.

lunch2_seo_5b_yuna.name: {name}
lunch2_seo_5b_yuna.text: I was curious what lunch on the rooftop with the student council president would be like.

lunch2_dain_1b.name: {name}
lunch2_dain_1b.text: *To the store with Dain. First order of business: rock-paper-scissors match.*

lunch2_dain_1b_seo.name: {name}
lunch2_dain_1b_seo.text: *To the store with Dain. Yesterday it was a lunchbox. Today the smell of bread hits first.*

lunch2_dain_2b_seo.name: Dain
lunch2_dain_2b_seo.text: Oh, my side today instead of the prez's lunchbox?!

lunch2_dain_3b_seo.name: {name}
lunch2_dain_3b_seo.text: Yesterday was the president's pace. Today I wanted to see your pace too.

lunch2_dain_4b_seo.name: Dain
lunch2_dain_4b_seo.text: YES!! No takebacks! One round, crumble bun on the line!!

lunch2_dain_1b_yuna.name: {name}
lunch2_dain_1b_yuna.text: *To the store with Dain. Yesterday it was a quiet library. Today the smell of bread and the noise hit first.*

lunch2_dain_2b_yuna.name: Dain
lunch2_dain_2b_yuna.text: Wait! Yesterday you went total ghost-mode and today you're here to actually have fun?!

lunch2_dain_3b_yuna.name: {name}
lunch2_dain_3b_yuna.text: If I went somewhere quiet, I should try somewhere loud too.

lunch2_dain_4b_yuna.name: Dain
lunch2_dain_4b_yuna.text: YES!! Respect the balance! One round, let's go!!

lunch2_yuna_1.name: {name}
lunch2_yuna_1.text: *The library annex. An older building than the main one. Almost no students around. I climb the stairs and at the end of the hallway, Yuna is standing there. Leaning against the wall, reading a book.*

lunch2_yuna_5_seo.name: Yuna
lunch2_yuna_5_seo.text: Yesterday you were with the president.

lunch2_yuna_6_seo.name: {name}
lunch2_yuna_6_seo.text: Today you were the one who called me here.

lunch2_yuna_8_seo.name: {name}
lunch2_yuna_8_seo.text: That made me want to come even more.

lunch2_yuna_4_yuna.name: {name}
lunch2_yuna_4_yuna.text: You even sent me a note this time.

lunch2_yuna_5_yuna.name: Yuna
lunch2_yuna_5_yuna.text: Yesterday was quiet too. Today as well?

lunch2_yuna_6_yuna.name: {name}
lunch2_yuna_6_yuna.text: Yesterday was comfortable. So I came back.

lunch2_yuna_8_yuna.name: {name}
lunch2_yuna_8_yuna.text: Yeah. Sitting next to you wasn't as uncomfortable as I expected.

lunch2_yuna_7.name: Yuna
lunch2_yuna_7.text: Looks like you're getting close with the loud one. That's more fun, isn't it?

lunch2_yuna_8.name: {name}
lunch2_yuna_8.text: Sometimes I need somewhere to escape to.

lunch2_yuna_9.name: {name}
lunch2_yuna_9.text: *Yuna smiles. Just barely. — But I caught it. Maybe that's what I came here for.*

lunch2_yuna_11.name: {name}
lunch2_yuna_11.text: *Yuna walks ahead. Deep into the annex. Somewhere no one would think to go. A small room appears. Sunlight streams in through the window, and there's a worn sofa and bookshelves.*

lunch2_yuna_13.name: {name}
lunch2_yuna_13.text: What is this place? Some kind of secret reading room?

lunch2_yuna_15.name: {name}
lunch2_yuna_15.text: *Yuna sits on the sofa. She quietly leaves the spot next to her open.*

lunch2_yuna_16.name: Yuna
lunch2_yuna_16.text: There used to be one other person who came here.

lunch2_yuna_choice.name: {name}
lunch2_yuna_choice.text: *She doesn't finish the sentence. Past tense. — Should I ask?*
choices: Don't ask. Just sit down next to her.

lunch2_yuna_c1_4.name: {name}
lunch2_yuna_c1_4.text: *A shadow crosses Yuna's face. I don't know who that 'someone' was, but—*

lunch2_yuna_c1_6.name: Yuna
lunch2_yuna_c1_6.text: ...I don't know. Whether they didn't — or couldn't.

lunch2_yuna_c1_7.name: {name}
lunch2_yuna_c1_7.text: *Yuna opens her book. A signal that the conversation is over. I need to change the mood. — Let me brush it off with something light.*

lunch2_yuna_c1_9.name: {name}
lunch2_yuna_c1_9.text: Maybe they had to leave in a rush? Sometimes things just slip through the cracks like that.

lunch2_yuna_c1_10.name: Yuna
lunch2_yuna_c1_10.text: ...It was a transfer. Not a slip.

lunch2_yuna_c1_12.name: {name}
lunch2_yuna_c1_12.text: *I screwed up. Trying to lighten the mood made it sound like I was brushing off her hurt. An awkward silence settles in. Just the sound of pages turning.*

lunch2_yuna_c1_14.name: {name}
lunch2_yuna_c1_14.text: *I always thought I read people well. — Apparently not this one.*

lunch2_yuna_c2_1.name: {name}
lunch2_yuna_c2_1.text: *I sit down next to her without a word. Yuna glances over briefly. Then she takes one book from her own pile and sets it down on my side.*

lunch2_yuna_c2_4.name: {name}
lunch2_yuna_c2_4.text: *A book instead of words. We read side by side in silence. The sunlight coming through the window is warm.*

lunch2_yuna_c2_6.name: Yuna
lunch2_yuna_c2_6.text: ...This is why I like it here.

lunch2_yuna_c2_8.name: Yuna
lunch2_yuna_c2_8.text: It's quiet. — But I'm not alone.

lunch2_yuna_c2_9.name: {name}
lunch2_yuna_c2_9.text: *Two whole sentences. From Yuna, that's basically a speech. — And everything she means is packed into them.*

lunch2_yuna_end.name: {name}
lunch2_yuna_end.text: *Yuna's 'used to be' is still echoing in my head. What it means that she brought me here — it's slowly starting to land.*

lunch2_seo_1.name: {name}
lunch2_seo_1.text: *The rooftop. Same spot as yesterday. Seoyeon is setting out her lunchbox.*

lunch2_seo_7.name: {name}
lunch2_seo_7.text: *She looked like she wanted me to keep going — but I held back on purpose. We're eating when the rooftop door opens. Dain just walked in.*

lunch2_seo_11.name: Dain
lunch2_seo_11.text: C'mon, you don't need a permit to eat lunch. Oh wait — IS that a homemade lunchbox?! That looks amazing!

lunch2_seo_12.name: {name}
lunch2_seo_12.text: *Dain sits down without hesitation. Seoyeon's brow furrows ever so slightly.*

lunch2_seo_13.name: Dain
lunch2_seo_13.text: We met yesterday! He's really cheerful, right Prez?!

lunch2_seo_13b.name: Dain
lunch2_seo_13b.text: Oh! You're the council president? Nice to meet you!

lunch2_seo_14.name: Seoyeon
lunch2_seo_14.text: *Watching Dain leave* ...She's got a lot of energy. *Closing the lunchbox lid, quietly* I usually come up here alone.

lunch2_seo_15.name: {name}
lunch2_seo_15.text: We just know each other from class.

lunch2_seo_17.name: {name}
lunch2_seo_17.text: *...That's probably what Dain would say. The tension between these two is getting sharper. — I'm starting to feel less like a participant and more like the prize.*

lunch2_seo_20.name: Seoyeon
lunch2_seo_20.text: You have something on your lip. Hold still.

lunch2_seo_c1_1.name: {name}
lunch2_seo_c1_1.text: *Seoyeon's finger brushes the corner of my lips. Softly. Slowly. — Slower than necessary.*

lunch2_seo_c1_5.name: {name}
lunch2_seo_c1_5.text: *Three seconds to wipe off a grain of rice? — Nobody else would notice, but the tips of Seoyeon's ears are red.*

lunch2_seo_end_c1.name: {name}
lunch2_seo_end_c1.text: *Where Seoyeon's hand passed still feels hot. — And Dain's surprised eyes keep coming back to me.*

lunch2_seo_c2_1.name: {name}
lunch2_seo_c2_1.text: *I wipe my mouth with the back of my hand.*

lunch2_seo_c2_2.name: Seoyeon
lunch2_seo_c2_2.text: ...If you do it yourself, you'll just make it worse.

lunch2_seo_c2_3.name: {name}
lunch2_seo_c2_3.text: *She looks a little put out. — But her composure holds perfectly. Classic Seoyeon.*

lunch2_seo_end_c2.name: {name}
lunch2_seo_end_c2.text: *There's still a smudge on the back of my hand. Seoyeon's composure is flawless — but the corners of her lips have dipped just slightly.*

lunch2_dain_1.name: {name}
lunch2_dain_1.text: *To the snack bar with Dain. A rematch of yesterday's rock-paper-scissors.*

lunch2_dain_2.name: Dain
lunch2_dain_2.text: You're going down today!! Get ready!!

lunch2_dain_3.name: {name}
lunch2_dain_3.text: You said the same thing yesterday.

lunch2_dain_8.name: Dain
lunch2_dain_8.text: Ah, alright... Two crumble buns, please...

lunch2_dain_9.name: {name}
lunch2_dain_9.text: *We buy bread and stand by the hallway windows. — Then Seoyeon walks by, carrying a lunchbox.*

lunch2_dain_10.name: {name}
lunch2_dain_10.text: *Seoyeon looks this way. She stares at me standing next to Dain, eating bread, for half a second — then walks past. Something stings in my chest.*

lunch2_dain_11.name: Dain
lunch2_dain_11.text: Hey, what's with the president? Why's she staring?

lunch2_dain_13.name: Dain
lunch2_dain_13.text: Hmm... are you close with the president too?

lunch2_dain_choice.name: {name}
choices: She just showed me around the school?

lunch2_dain_c1_1.name: {name}
lunch2_dain_c1_1.text: *Dain's expression subtly stiffens. She takes a bite of crumble bun and turns her head away. — Did I just hurt her?*

lunch2_dain_c2_1.name: {name}
lunch2_dain_c2_1.text: *Dain nods and takes a bite of crumble bun. Acting like she doesn't care.*

lunch2_dain_c3_1.name: Dain
lunch2_dain_c3_1.text: Hey, don't laugh! *breaks crumble bun in half and shoves one piece over* ...Here, just eat this.

lunch2_dain_c3_2.name: {name}
lunch2_dain_c3_2.text: *Her earlobes. Red. — The girls at this school really can't hide a thing.*

lunch2_dain_end.name: {name}
lunch2_dain_end.text: *The crunching of Dain's crumble bun is unusually loud. — Lunch period is getting more complicated by the day.*

lunch2_yuna_c1_9_b.name: {name}
lunch2_yuna_c1_9_b.text: *Yuna's gaze turns cold for an instant.*

lunch2_seo_c1_2_b.name: {name}
lunch2_seo_c1_2_b.text: *Dain's eyes widen as she looks back and forth between the two of us.*

lunch2_seo_c1_3_b.name: Seoyeon
lunch2_seo_c1_3_b.text: *Acting like nothing happened* It was a grain of rice.

lunch2_dain_13_b.name: {name}
lunch2_dain_13_b.text: *Dain takes an exaggeratedly big bite of her crumble bun. Like the question she just asked wasn't a big deal.*

lunch2_dain_end_b.name: {name}
lunch2_dain_end_b.text: *Fifth period PE. Running on the field when — the guy next to me stops short and we collide. My elbow gets scraped. Nothing serious, but it's bleeding a little.*

lunch2_dain_end_c.name: PE Teacher
lunch2_dain_end_c.text: Go to the nurse's office and get it disinfected.

lunch2_dain_end_d.name: {name}
lunch2_dain_end_d.text: *I open the nurse's office door. Same antiseptic smell as yesterday.*

lunch2_dain_end_ins4_first.name: {name}
lunch2_dain_end_ins4_first.text: *I open the door to the nurse's office. An unfamiliar scent of antiseptic tickles my nose.*

lunch2_dain_end_ins5_first.name: School Nurse
lunch2_dain_end_ins5_first.text: *Looks up* First time here, right? You're the transfer student.

lunch2_dain_end_g.name: School Nurse
lunch2_dain_end_g.text: Back again? Trying to become a regular?

lunch2_dain_end_ins7_first.name: School Nurse
lunch2_dain_end_ins7_first.text: First time, huh? That happens. Come on, let's disinfect it.

lunch2_dain_end_h.name: {name}
lunch2_dain_end_h.text: *Same playful tone as yesterday. But her eyes are already examining the wound.*

lunch2_dain_end_ins8_first.name: {name}
lunch2_dain_end_ins8_first.text: *Same playful tone as always. But her eyes are already examining the wound.*

lunch2_dain_end_i.name: {name}
lunch2_dain_end_i.text: *The nurse comes over and takes my elbow. Her hands are cold.*

lunch2_dain_end_k.name: {name}
lunch2_dain_end_k.text: *She takes out a cotton ball soaked in antiseptic — and dabs slowly. Pulls out a bandage. Putting on one bandage — should take 30 seconds, why is she being so meticulous?*

lunch2_dain_end_l.name: School Nurse
lunch2_dain_end_l.text: *Applying the bandage* Here... like this... there, done.

lunch2_dain_end_m.name: {name}
lunch2_dain_end_m.text: *The nurse's hand pauses. Then — as if nothing happened — it moves again.*

lunch2_dain_end_n.name: School Nurse
lunch2_dain_end_n.text: ...My hands tend to be cold. Guess they're warm today.

lunch2_dain_end_o.name: {name}
lunch2_dain_end_o.text: *That's not true. When she first touched me, they were cold. — They only got warm just now.*

lunch2_dain_end_p.name: School Nurse
lunch2_dain_end_p.text: *Grinning* It's called bedside manner. Years of practice.

lunch2_dain_end_q.name: {name}
lunch2_dain_end_q.text: *Bedside manner... is that really all it is?*

lunch2_dain_end_r.name: {name}
lunch2_dain_end_r.text: *Checking the bandage — I notice a notebook poking out of her desk drawer. Pale green cover. The open page has something written in letter form. 'Yujin, today—' That's as far as I read before the nurse closes the drawer.*

lunch2_dain_end_s.name: School Nurse
lunch2_dain_end_s.text: *Narrowing her eyes* Just one? ...Hmm, fine then. I prefer cocoa to coffee. That's the secret.

lunch2_dain_end_t.name: {name}
lunch2_dain_end_t.text: *As secrets go, it's harmless enough. But the act of sharing it — that means something.*

lunch2_dain_end_u.name: School Nurse
lunch2_dain_end_u.text: *Laughs softly* Secret. Teachers get to have secrets too, you know.

lunch2_dain_end_v.name: {name}
lunch2_dain_end_v.text: *She plays it off with a joke, but she closed that drawer fast. — There's something she doesn't want seen.*

lunch2_dain_end_w.name: School Nurse
lunch2_dain_end_w.text: All done, so get back to class. — Next time you show up, I'm adding items to the checkup list.

lunch2_dain_end_x.name: {name}
lunch2_dain_end_x.text: If I'm not hurt, I'd have no reason to come.

lunch2_dain_end_y.name: {name}
lunch2_dain_end_y.text: *The nurse pauses. And then — her voice drops a tone.*

lunch2_dain_end_z.name: School Nurse
lunch2_dain_end_z.text: You can come even without a reason.

lunch2_dain_end_b2.name: {name}
lunch2_dain_end_b2.text: *The playfulness is gone. Then it comes back. — That just now, I caught it.*

lunch2_dain_end_c2.name: School Nurse
lunch2_dain_end_c2.text: *Brightening up again* Oh, but not during class. After school.

lunch2_dain_end_d2.name: {name}
lunch2_dain_end_d2.text: *That shift in her voice just now. — Was I imagining things?*

lunch2_dain_end_nurse_short1.name: School Nurse
lunch2_dain_end_nurse_short1.text: There, all done. Try not to get hurt next time.

lunch2_dain_end_nurse_short2.name: {name}
lunch2_dain_end_nurse_short2.text: *Got the bandage and left the nurse's office. — It felt more comfortable than it looked from outside.*

lunch2_dain_end_nurse_short3.name: {name}
lunch2_dain_end_nurse_short3.text: *I could probably come back after school.*
